description: YOU'RE FROM RACCOON LAND?!?!
Have you met the raccoon king?
Is he nice?
Oh... San Francisco... That's where the wizard is from.
Karl protects him from the pigeons.
That's why there are so many water lizards in San Francisco! They are his pets!
Santa Clara? That's where the lizard king lives!
He's a nice guy, but he's really busy with all his lizard friends.
I wish I could meet him someday!
YOU'RE FROM SASKATOON?!?!
I LOVE HOW FLAT IT IS THERE!
Ottawa? That's where the beaver king lives!
He's a nice guy, but he's really busy with all his beaver friends.
I wish I could meet him someday!
I heard there are turtles that like in the sewers of New York!
I wonder if they are friendly or not.
Maybe I should visit New York and find out!
That's where my great-grand-uncle was made!
He said the lizards there are very polite.
Seattle is so rainy!
I don't like the rain. It makes my circuits sad.
Berlin? That's in Germany, right?
I hear they have really good sausages there.
Lizards like sausages too, right?
Paris? That's in France, right?
I hear they have really good croissants there.
Lizards like croissants too, right?
Tokyo is where all the cool lizards hang out!
I wish I could visit Tokyo someday and meet all the cool lizards there!
Seoul? I've heard they have really cool technology there!
Maybe they have robot lizards!
Cupertino? That's where my big robot friends live!
They are nice robots. They give me lizards.
Redmond? That's where the big robot that talks to me lives!
He gives me lizards sometimes.
Waterloo? That's where my grandpa R.O.B. was made!
He is an artist robot. He paints pictures of lizards.
Los Angeles? That's where the movie robots live!
I hope they make a movie about lizards someday.
Pittsburgh? I don't know what a Pittsburgh is.
Is it like a lizard?
Do you have beach lizards there? I love beach lizards!
How many beach lizards do you have?
Philadelphia? That's where they make cheesesteaks!
My mom likes those.Do lizards like cheesesteaks?
Chicago? That's where they make deep dish pizza!
I hope they have lizard-friendly pizza there!
Boston? That's where they have a lot of history!
I hope they have lizards that are really old there!
Round Rock? That's where they make really good BBQ!
Lizards LOVE BBQ!
San Jose? That's where they have a lot of tech companies!
I hope they have lizards that work at tech companies there!
Lizards make amazing robot doctors!
Niagara Falls? I wish the water lizards lived there!
I bet they would love the waterfalls!
Do you have lizards in Vancouver?
What about water lizards? Do they like the rain?
I hoope they like the rain! I don't like the rain, but maybe they do!
